description:
About this item
PREMIUM QUALITY: Rainforce 16 oz glass jars for food storage with lids is made of high quality thick glass that resists cracking and breaking. The glass of these 16 oz mason jars are 100% food safe and lead-free for healthy food storage and beverage drinking. For your convenience, these 16 oz jars are also designed to be dishwasher safe
CLASSIC DESIGN: The crystal clear and smooth design of these canning jars ensure the highest visibility possible, allowing you to easily see the contents inside. Every 16 oz jars involved a metal screw-on lid with plastisol liner that ensures an airtight seal, which will keep beverages tasting fresh and prevent dry foods from going stale.
CLASSIFIED STORAGE: These 15 pack bulk mason jars come with 20 free labels, which will make these mason jars an ideal classified organizational tool for everything from homemade pickles and jams to spices and herbs to cosmetics or homemade candles. Perfect for preserving and canning enthusiasts.
WIDE RANGE OF USE: The multifunctional jars with lids are useful for canning, storing, and decorative purposes. From your pantry to the world of experimental cuisine these pint mason jars is perfect for the creative and unusualtable setting, and they are also the perfect canvas for adorning with decorations for arts and crafts, wedding and party favors, and other DIY projects.
EASY TO USE/CLEAN: The regular mouth canning jars have a 2.5" diameter opening for trouble-free filling of fruits, veggies, herbs, and spices. The wide opening also allows easy accessibility to the bottom of the jar for an easy and thorough cleaning by no matter dishwasher or hand with a sponge.

reviews_1s:
They call them canning jars and it is not clear from the description that the lids and not two piece. I have only canned with two piece lids so I had to go out and buy more. These less expensive jars now have become more expensive to me. Then is seems that standard two piece Ball Brand lids and rings do not fit these at all well. No jars broke during the canning process, but the seals are not consistant. What a waste of time, money and ingredients!My wife and I ordered these "mason" jars out of desperation due to shortages in the local grocery stores. I initially thought it was strange that they came 15 jars to a pack rather than 12 jars. At first glance, they looked good, but when I put them on the table in preparation to pour honey into them, I learned that they were slightly shorter and slightly greater in diameter than standard mason jars. The oversized diameter means I cannot put them in 12-jar cardboard boxes for easy transport or storage.
The 15-jar pack in which they came is unwieldy, and the labels were hidden out of sight under the padding. The labels were also black. How can I possibly write on a black label?
To say that I am disappointed is an understatement.Description says it is suitable for canning. The lids are not appropriate for canning and would be unsafe for food preservation. False advertising and potentially dangerous to customers without experience.One was shattered by the time the package was delivered. None of the packaging was damaged at all. Then we used two of them for the first time and both broke! One was jostled in the sink (it was already sitting in the sink) and broke when it bumped into the sink wall. The other shattered in-hand while hand-washing it! At this rate I'll have to buy a new set pretty soon, but it's definitely going to be a different brand.I purchased these to use for canning. Was advised by my local agriculture department that these were not FDA approved. Therefore everything I used for canning cannot be used for entry into county fairs. The single lid does not seal properly.
I tried replacing with regular mouth ball canning lids. They do not fit properly. It was a waste of time money and product. I have a refrigerator full of salsa that I'm giving away as fast as I can.Lids are one-piece. When used, they must be disposed of. To reuse the jars, new lids as well as bands must be purchased. However, the glass is so thin that some of the jars did not stand up to the internal pressure produced by canningl: Their bottoms broke off meaning that the contents were also lost. Additionally the lids loosen during processing so that even those that survived were not necessarily sealed properly. These jars are not a bargain. I'll not be purchasing them againI’ve had to throw a few of my jars away due to this issue losing money.I used these jars to can peaches. Received a pack of 15 jars but used 8 in my 1st batch. 2 broke and now I'm afraid to use the rest! It's not only a waste of money but also a waste of all of that time (canning is a tedious process) and I had to throw away the peaches!I bought these thinking I could use them for water bath canning if I used Ball two part lids after reading the reviews. While I was canning I heard an explosion. Several of the Ball lids had burst off ruining their contents. Maybe the thread size on these jars differ from the Ball jars the lids are made for?Used to store home made sour cream. After several jars shattered with just the use of a spoon stirring the contents, I can no longer use them for food. VERY disappointing.
